notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
[u]The major update[/u] brought about a new game mode - [b]hardcore mode[/b]. (A game mode for hardcore gamers.) After dying you will return to the beginning of the scene. Therefore completing the game will be far more difficult. [b]GOOD LUCK![/b]

[i]- Bugs are fixed with disappearance of savings
- Some storytelling chambers are corrected in one scene
- Colliders are adjusted in two scenes
- The position of energy shields are changed in the bottom of the screen[/i]

notes.title: Updates and Fixes
notes.content:
- The type of monologue has changed. (Now it's on top)
- Fixed some minor bugs.
- Removed stops due to the monologues of the characters.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
-Fixed video hang on some PCs
-Changed the foundation in some rooms
-Modified Floor Colliders
-Fixed a menu error related with switching resolution.
-Added the ability to report a bug in the Main Menu
